title: Counters Beginner - 6-Day
description: Fundamental defensive responses to Jab-Cross and Jab-Hook attacks. Learn the first 8 essential counters for each series.

days.notes: COUNTERS 1-4 (Jab-Cross): Shoulder Roll, Pari Nan Tek, Inside Wedge, Low Line Hit. Practice proper timing and structure.
days.notes_fr: RIPOSTES 1-4 (Jab-Cross) : Shoulder Roll, Pari Nan Tek, Inside Wedge, Low Line Hit. Travaillez le timing et la structure corrects.

days.notes: COUNTERS 5-8 (Jab-Cross): Internal/External High Line Hits, Biu Ji entries. Focus on non-telegraphed ripostes.
days.notes_fr: RIPOSTES 5-8 (Jab-Cross) : High Line Hits interne/externe, entrées Biu Ji. Concentrez-vous sur des ripostes sans anticipation.

days.notes: COUNTERS 1-8 (Jab-Cross): Integration. Flow smoothly between different defensive responses.
days.notes_fr: RIPOSTES 1-8 (Jab-Cross) : Intégration. Enchaînez fluidement entre les différentes réponses défensives.

days.notes: Rest day. Mental review of the Jab-Cross counters.
days.notes_fr: Journée de repos. Révision mentale des ripostes Jab-Cross.

days.notes: COUNTERS 1-4 (Jab-Hook): Cover Coude, Inside Wedge, Insinida, Bob Wave. Focus on closing the gap safely.
days.notes_fr: RIPOSTES 1-4 (Jab-Hook) : Cover Coude, Inside Wedge, Insinida, Bob Wave. Concentrez-vous sur la fermeture sûre de la distance.

days.notes: COUNTERS 5-8 (Jab-Hook): Shoulder Stops, White Cover, Panatukan, Silat. Advanced defensive structures.
days.notes_fr: RIPOSTES 5-8 (Jab-Hook) : Shoulder Stops, White Cover, Panatukan, Silat. Structures défensives avancées.

Author: Antoine Giniès
description_fr: Réponses défensives fondamentales aux attaques Jab-Cross et Jab-Hook. Apprenez les 8 premières ripostes essentielles de chaque série.
